title: prisma migrate reset
description: Understand database reset mechanics, when to wipe local development databases, and how seed scripts run automatically.

data.text: During early development, when experimenting with complex relational models, you may introduce conflicting schema migrations that cannot be reconciled cleanly. `prisma migrate reset` drops the local database, recreates it, executes all migration scripts from scratch, and triggers your seed script.

data.title: Running Migrate Reset
data.content: Completely rebuilds your local development database.
data.code:
# Resets local DB and prompts for confirmation
npx prisma migrate reset

# Force reset without interactive confirmation (useful in test scripts)
npx prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed

data.title: Production Safeguard
data.text: `prisma migrate reset` refuses to run if it detects a production environment variable or if the database is detected to be non-local, preventing disastrous data loss.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: `prisma migrate reset` drops and recreates the development database.
It automatically triggers your seed script configured in `package.json`.
Never use reset on any environment containing real user data.
